summary: Verified INSTANT Health Card update on /portal/account for maria.lopez@demo.com. Backend pytest (6/6) and Playwright UI both pass. POST /api/portal/profile/health-card writes directly, returns {ok:true, health_card_display:'1234 567 890 XD'}, and GET /api/portal/overview immediately reflects new fields with health_card_update_pending=false and no pending_health_card object. Toast reads 'Health Card updated.' with no 'pending clinic verification' text; new masked value appears in acct-hc immediately and persists after reload. Validation (10 digits + 2 letters) still blocks bad input. Expiry alarm banners intact: acct-hc-warn-soon with badge 'Expiring soon' at expiry <=60d, acct-hc-warn-expired with badge 'Expired' when past. Regression: phone edit (acct-edit-phone/acct-phone-save) applies instantly. Restored Maria Lopez to a valid future expiry (2028-09-22) at end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2741 lines - consider splitting into routers (portal, internal, auth, applications) for maintainability.

portal_submit_health_card audit payload logs previous HC number/version in plaintext ('before' dict) - acceptable for internal audit collection but ensure this collection is access-controlled and not exposed via any API.
